arabic.text:
- مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، تَذْكِرَةُ ذَهَابٍ وَإِيَابٍ إِلَى إِدِنْبَرَة.
- بِالقِطَارِ السَّرِيعِ؟ السِّعْرُ ثَمَانُونَ جُنَيْهًا.
- مَتَى يُغَادِرُ القِطَارُ؟
- فِي السَّاعَةِ التَّاسِعَةِ، وَيَصِلُ بَعْدَ أَرْبَعِ سَاعَاتٍ.

blocks.task: say the Arabic, turn over and check, or play pairs with a partner.

questions.q: Say: the journey takes three hours by train.
What does the return ticket cost?
Role play (our own, 1AA0 style) in breakout pairs: buy a ticket, ask the time and duration, and give a preference; then write the dialogue (8 lines) in the portal response box.
questions.a: Accurate dialogue with times, cost, duration and an opinion

questions.q: Extend: compare train and plane to Scotland in 40 words.
How long is the journey to Edinburgh?
questions.a: A) Four hours. يَصِلُ بَعْدَ أَرْبَعِ سَاعَاتٍ.
